context:
Goal: phones are shared across repos with no clash and no waste.
Problem (rule, stale decision): record sim-lease-tool, ruling 4, says "The reuse path takes no lease", and test case 50 in lint/test_sim_test.sh expects it. That is why two runs held Duo 1 at once.
Based on (read): the record and case 50.
Departs from: main, where a reuse takes no lease — a reuse takes the lease of the booted slot, skips the load bars (no boot), waits while another live run holds it, and gives it back at cleanup.
Meanwhile: the lane builds on a, and sends nothing to the batch runner until you answer.

options.gain: No two runs ever share one phone; the status shows who holds each booted phone.
options.label: Rewrite ruling 4: a reuse takes the lease (recommended)
options.lose: A run that reuses a phone may now wait for it.

options.label: Keep ruling 4 as it is
options.lose: Two runs can still drive one phone at once.

ref: decision sim-lease-tool ruling 4; lint/test_sim_test.sh case 50; step sim-lease-gaps
reply: You picked a: ruling 4 of sim-lease-tool is rewritten; a reuse takes the booted phone's lease. Sent to lane sim-lease-gaps at 12:35 CST; home: step sim-lease-gaps. Closed.
short: Shared phones: a reused phone takes the lease
title: Shared iPhone simulators: may a run that reuses an already-booted phone take that phone's lease, which an old ruling forbids?
why: This is gap 1 from your Mac's notes (commit b7bc81da): two runs drove Duo 1 at once today, and the Home review lost 7 tries.
